description: Expected results for ISSM NightlyRun test101 (SquareShelfConstrainedStressSSA2d): 2D SSA stress balance of a square, fully floating ice shelf, 50 km mesh (340 vertices), 2 MPI ranks. All 13 field checks use the official reference file test/Archives/Archive101.arch and the official per-field tolerances from test101.py, with the same error formula as test/NightlyRun/runme.py. The two KI-tool checks use max/mean of the official Vel archive field.

numeric_checks.why: ice velocity x (m/yr), 340 vertices; ISSM's own NightlyRun check: max|run-archive| / (max|archive| + eps) must be <= the tolerance written in test101.py

finished_normally: test101.py driver exits 0, md.results.StressbalanceSolution exists, issm.exe wrote a non-empty .outbin and an empty .errlog; KI tool run_issm.py exits 0 with status 'success' in results.json
recorded_with: official values: Archive101.arch shipped in ISSM git (not from our run)
notes: Inputs are unmodified. The only run-time addition is a generic_settings.py file (ISSM's own user-settings hook for the generic cluster class) written into the temp run dir so issm.exe writes its run files to the temp dir instead of $ISSM_DIR/execution. It sets only executionpath and does not touch the model.
